answer: A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the gale value does not exist until the window has already shut. Because the cipher beacon round is committed in advance, the sparrow audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 13 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
